title: LoomKV: Lossless KV Cache Compression from GPU Memory to SSD for LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2611.32954v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving engines offload the key/value (KV) cache from GPU memory to host DRAM and SSD so multi-turn and agent requests can reuse prompt prefixes. Capacity then limits service at two levels: external tiers govern prefix reuse before eviction, while the GPU KV pool bounds concurrent long requests, and lossy compression alters KV values and outputs. LoomKV brings lossless KV compression to both external tiers (tier mode) and the GPU pool (pool mode) on an unmodified engine. Using a calibrated per-head two-level 3-bit code over BF16 high bytes (sign and upper seven exponent bits), LoomKV stores BF16 KV at 0.71 of its raw size across nine models and FP8 KV at 0.85-0.87. In tier mode, TileStream writes exact-length records with length readback off the load path, leaving tier storage, eviction, and prefetch unchanged, and decompresses fetched records straight into scattered GPU pages. translated_title: LoomKV：面向大语言模型服务的从GPU内存到SSD的无损KV缓存压缩
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）服务引擎将键值（KV）缓存从GPU内存卸载到主机DRAM和SSD，以便多轮对话和智能体请求能够重用提示前缀。容量在两个层面限制服务：外部层级在数据淘汰前管理前缀重用，而GPU KV池则限制并发长请求的数量，且有损压缩会改变KV值和模型输出。LoomKV在无需修改服务引擎的情况下，将无损KV压缩同时应用于外部存储层级（层级模式）和GPU内存池（池模式）。通过对BF16高字节（符号位及最高七位指数位）采用经过校准的每注意力头两级3位编码，LoomKV在九个模型上将BF16 KV以原始大小的0.71进行存储，FP8 KV则以0.85-0.87的比例存储。在层级模式下，TileStream写入精确长度的记录并在加载路径之外进行长度回读，保持层级存储、淘汰和预取机制不变，并将取回的记录直接解压缩到分散的GPU页面中。在池模式下，FragPack对变长数据块进行打包……
tldr: LoomKV提出了一种无需修改服务引擎的无损KV缓存压缩方法，同时作用于外部存储层级和GPU内存池，在九个模型上将BF16 KV缓存压缩至原始大小的0.71且不改变模型输出。
en_tdlr: LoomKV introduces lossless KV cache compression for both external storage tiers and the GPU pool on an unmodified LLM serving engine, reducing BF16 KV storage to 0.71 of its raw size across nine models without altering model outputs.
